jobs.description:
In this role, you are responsible for managing, analyzing, and interpreting the entire range of TradeMarks products as well as several Private Labels in our Product Cataloguing systems. You will keep the product data and cataloguing data of our own brands and private label product data up-to-date and consistent in various databases (e.g., LIS, PIM, ADMIN, TecDoc, X-checker, etc.). Analyzing data across different systems to identify and correct discrepancies and inconsistencies. This work is primarily done using Excel.

 

Responsibilities:

• You assist in optimizing cataloguing processes and data flows. You ensure that data efficiently and accurately flows from our internal systems to various other systems such as websites, platforms, customer portals, etc.
• You support various data update processes and always do so within the agreed timelines.
• You ensure top-quality cataloguing product data, which adds value for our customers.
• You configure data into the formats desired by customers and the various digital formats used in automotive industry catalogues.
• You support both the Product and Marketing teams with analyses and overviews of the cataloguing product data.
• Additionally, you play a crucial role in developing and implementing data management processes and procedures to ensure data quality and accuracy.
• You work closely with the managers of the various databases and other colleagues on data and database optimization and maintenance. You take action where necessary.
• You serve as a backup for the product data specialists.
• 
Moreover, you will have the opportunity to grow in your role and take responsibility for (sub)projects within the Product Cataloguing processes

 

Job Requirements:

• You have at least a bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
• You have some experience in Data Management (1-5 years), preferably in the Automotive and/or Chemical sector.
• You possess excellent computer skills:
• Excel: advanced (knowledge of pivots, vlookups, concatenates, comparing different data files, etc.)
• Access DB: basic, i.e., loading tables (manually or via import), basic queries, etc.
• Knowledge of cataloguing data systems is an advantage: PIM, TecDoc, X-checker.
• You speak and write fluent Dutch and English. Any other language is a plus.
• You are interested in quality product information, have a keen eye for detail, and work very accurately. You are also eager to continuously expand your knowledge.
• You prefer a structured approach to task follow-up and are capable of working independently. At the same time, you are a team player who relies on and draws upon the expertise of colleagues to help you in your daily tasks.
• You possess good and detailed analytical skills. You are able to work with data from different sources that are not 100% identical and find ways to link this data from various sources.
• You can set priorities, enabling you to consistently achieve the set objectives and deadlines.
• 
Additionally, you are an innovative thinker, always looking for improvements and opportunities in the market. Your organizational skills allow you to effectively manage projects and handle multiple tasks simultaneously.

The IT manager will roll out the IT strategy, and lead the department ensuring the effective planning, implementation, and maintenance of all IT systems and infrastructure within the organization. The IT Manager plays a pivotal role in aligning technology strategies with the overall business objectives, fostering innovation, and ensuring the security and reliability of the IT environment.

Responsibilities:

• IT strategy: Define and implement the IT vision and strategy of the company and translate into a coherent roadmap. 
• IT PMO: Manage the IT-portfolio with respect to planning, budget, risks and ensuring adequate resource staffing together with providers and business
• IT Goverance: Ensure adequate governance throughout the lifecyle of projects from inception to completion, ensuring timely delivery and budget adherence. 
• Technology Evaluation: Stay abreast of emerging technologies, assess their potential for the organization, and make recommendations for adoption. 
• IT Operations: Oversee all technology operations and evaluate them according to established goals and service levels. 
• Incident Management: Ensure a stable IT landscape and close follow up and resolution of incidents and problems. 
• Infrastructure Management: Oversee the design, implementation, and maintenance of the organization's IT infrastructure, including networks, servers, and systems. 
• Security and Compliance: Establish and enforce security policies and procedures to protect the organization's digital assets. 
• Vendor Management: Evaluate and manage relationships with external vendors, negotiate contracts, and ensure service level agreements are met. 
• Team Management: Lead, mentor, and manage a small team of IT professionals, fostering a collaborative and high-performance work environment. 
• Stakeholder Management: manage relationships with internal stakeholders, ranging from employees to Exco-members, and external IT partners.

 

Skills: 

• Proven professional experience of min 5 years in IT management or a similar role. 

• Minimum bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related f ield. A Master's degree is preferred. 

• Relevant certifications such as PMP or ITIL are advantageous. 

• Experience in working in an outsourced IT service model 

• Experience in supplier management, experience in IT contract negotiations is a plus 

• Experience in negotiating and managing IT budgets 

• Able to work independently, self-motivated 

• Good language skills in English, French and Dutch 

• Strong leadership and management in leading IT initiatives and driving organizational change. 

• Strong organization abilities including ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects and activities among numerous tasks. 

• Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to identify and address complex technical issues. 

• Effective communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to convey technical information to non-technical stakeholders. 

• Good knowledge of ERP tools (ideally Microsoft tools like Business Central, Dynamics 365) is a plus 

• Good knowledge of the Microsoft technology stack, Azure, Intune, Defender, AD 

• Good knowledge of Cyber Security best practices, knowledge of a related framework (CIS Controls, ISO 27001)

As a quality and compliance expert, you will be responsible for ensuring that GxP systems and processes adhere to the applicable regulatory requirements throughout the entire system lifecycle. Therefore, you stay up to date about evolving regulations from authorities such as the EMA and FDA and industry standards like GAMP and ISO. Depending on your role and expertise, you may be asked to provide Quality & Compliance support during audits and inspections, or to join a Sopra Steria validation service team.

As a trusted Computerized System Validation (CSV) Engineer, you play a key role in the validation process of the computerized systems used by our clients in the Life Sciences sector. More specifically, your mission is to ensure the quality and regulatory compliance of GxP systems throughout their entire life cycle and across all GxP areas (GLP, GCP, GMP, GDP, GPvP). Systems in scope can include site-specific lab instruments (e.g. HPLC software) and production equipment (e.g. capsule filling machine), but also globally used web applications, Clinical Trial Management Systems, complex Manufacturing Execution Systems, SAP systems, medical devices, etc…
